questions.question: Exercises explained in the last month of pregnancy are all except:

options.B: Contracting abdominal muscles 474 E 475 B 476 C 477 D 478 A 479 A 34
options.C: Straight single leg raising with extended knee
options.D: Straight both leg raising with extended knee

questions.explanation: Straight double leg raising is avoided in late pregnancy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following exercise would be inappropriate for a woman who gave birth via cesarean section two days ago?
questions.explanation: Partial sit-ups are inappropriate two days after caesarean section.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Which of the following conditions would be considered an absolute contraindication to exercise?
questions.explanation: Phlebitis is an absolute contraindication to exercise.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A therapist develops exercise guidelines for a pregnant woman. Which of the following guideline is not accurate?

options.A: Deep flexion and extension of joints should be avoided
options.B: Heart rate should be measured at times of peak activity
options.C: Duration of exercise should be influenced by perceived exertion
options.D: Fluid intake should be limited before and after exercise

questions.explanation: Fluid intake should be encouraged, not limited, around exercise in pregnancy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A therapist designs an exercise program for a woman that is pregnant. The physician referral identifies diastasis recti as a secondary diagnosis. Diastasis recti is:

options.A: An incision made at the opening of the vagina to increases the diameter
options.B: When the embryo develops in the fallopian tube
options.C: A separation of the rectus abdominis muscle
options.D: When the placenta pulls away from the uterine wall

questions.explanation: Diastasis recti is separation of the rectus abdominis muscle.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A woman's pulmonary and cardiovascular systems are altered physiologically during pregnancy. Which of the following would a physical therapist expect to observe when examining a pregnant woman?

options.A: Decreased oxygen reserve ad decreased stroke volume
options.B: Increased oxygen reserve and increased stroke volume
options.C: Decreased oxygen reserve and increased cardiac output
options.D: Decreased stroke volume and decreased cardiac output

questions.explanation: Pregnancy reduces oxygen reserve (lower FRC) and raises cardiac output.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: A woman in her third trimester of pregnancy is referred to physical therapy with acute low back pain. During a postural examination the therapist identifies several significant findings. Which of the following postural findings is not commonly associated with pregnancy?

options.D: Protraction of the shoulder girdle Suspension

questions.explanation: Cervical lordosis increases, not decreases, in pregnancy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
